quest.title: Refreshing Fonta, a Font of Refreshment!
quest.description: In the Fontaine Research Institute, you encounter Heinry, a member of the Fonta development team, and he seems to be quite busy with something...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Location 1, by the water.

dialogues.speaker: Heinry
dialogues.text: No problem. I'm counting on you, then.

dialogues.speaker: Heinry
dialogues.text: Let's go with what we did previously... Here, take these two bottles of Fonta. They should serve as a nice pick-me-up beforehand.

dialogues.speaker: Heinry
dialogues.text: Seriously, what is this ludicrous research goal, and what state must I have been in when I wrote that...?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Location 2, in the water.

dialogues.speaker: Heinry
dialogues.text: No problem. I'm counting on you, then.

dialogues.speaker: Heinry
dialogues.text: Let's go with what we did previously... Here, take these two bottles of Fonta. They should serve as a nice pick-me-up beforehand.

dialogues.speaker: Heinry
dialogues.text: Seriously, what is this ludicrous research goal, and what state must I have been in when I wrote that...?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Location 3, next to the ruins.

dialogues.speaker: Heinry
dialogues.text: No problem. I'm counting on you, then.

dialogues.speaker: Heinry
dialogues.text: Let's go with what we did previously... Here, take these two bottles of Fonta. They should serve as a nice pick-me-up beforehand.

dialogues.speaker: Heinry
dialogues.text: Seriously, what is this ludicrous research goal, and what state must I have been in when I wrote that...?

dialogues.speaker: Heinry
dialogues.text: It's in your hands, Traveler. Do it for the Fonta!

dialogues.speaker: Heinry
dialogues.text: I can't believe you found these documents completely intact... You really are my lucky star!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh? Hang on, why do you look so shocked?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: You... didn't have any hopes for successful retrieval at all, did you?

dialogues.speaker: Heinry
dialogues.text: What? No! I swear on my Fonta that I've never thought that way!

choices.text: You'd best not have.

response.speaker: Heinry
response.text: *cough* Well! Uh, it's very good that we've retrieved these materials, in any case. Give me a moment to study their contents...

response.speaker: Black Screen
response.text: Heinry looks through the materials...

response.speaker: Heinry
response.text: This records the various methods we can use to adjust the Fonta's sweetness.

response.speaker: Heinry
response.text: Huh. Adding salt to Fonta to boost its flavor... Wow, past-me, what a novel thought!

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Looks like present-you has some reflection to do.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Uh... Paimon's not so sure about salty Fonta...

response.speaker: Heinry
response.text: Huh? Would you not like such a flavor?

response.speaker: Heinry
response.text: Oh, not to worry, the saltiness you'd get from the salt wouldn't be too intense. The drink would still slant toward a sweet taste overall.

response.speaker: Heinry
response.text: Well... But since you did help me retrieve my materials, the new flavor I'm gonna develop will also take your suggestions into account.

response.speaker: Heinry
response.text: Do you think that I should take the suggestion that this draft contains and add salt to Fonta?

choices.text: And have you asked the Fonta how it feels hearing that?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Just add it, I reckon that a little saltiness will do us good.

dialogues.speaker: Heinry
dialogues.text: Alright, then. Your will be done!

dialogues.speaker: Heinry
dialogues.text: I'll continue my research into new Fonta flavors. Once I've got a finished product, I'll be sure to have you try it.

dialogues.speaker: Heinry
dialogues.text: Saltiness, sweetness... Hmm... How do I balance both of these...?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Uh, let's leave the sweet flavor be, shall we?

dialogues.speaker: Heinry
dialogues.text: Alright, then. Your will be done!

dialogues.speaker: Heinry
dialogues.text: I'll continue my research into new Fonta flavors. Once I've got a finished product, I'll be sure to have you try it.

dialogues.speaker: Heinry
dialogues.text: Saltiness, sweetness... Hmm... How do I balance both of these...?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I reckon carbonation's for the best.

dialogues.speaker: Heinry
dialogues.text: Understood. I'll take your word on that.

dialogues.speaker: Heinry
dialogues.text: I'll continue my research into new Fonta flavors. Once I've got a finished product, I'll be sure to have you try it.

dialogues.speaker: Heinry
dialogues.text: Bubbly... Hmmm... Let me think...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I'd like to try uncarbonated Fonta out.

dialogues.speaker: Heinry
dialogues.text: Understood. I'll take your word on that.

dialogues.speaker: Heinry
dialogues.text: I'll continue my research into new Fonta flavors. Once I've got a finished product, I'll be sure to have you try it.

dialogues.speaker: Heinry
dialogues.text: Hmm. If we remove the fizz, we'll have to make the taste better elsewhere...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I think we should keep Fonta in its original state.

dialogues.speaker: Heinry
dialogues.text: Understood. I'll take your word on that first.

dialogues.speaker: Heinry
dialogues.text: Guess preservation's the way to go.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I'd like to try some carbonated tea, sure.

dialogues.speaker: Heinry
dialogues.text: Understood. I'll take your word on that first.

dialogues.speaker: Heinry
dialogues.text: Still, what sort of tea leaves should we use? Guess I should find someone well-versed in this field and ask them...

dialogues.speaker: Heinry
dialogues.text: Looks like I'll have to adjust my research direction... Well, not that it's the biggest problem ever...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Any new Fonta flavors available?

dialogues.speaker: Heinry
dialogues.text: Hello there. Unfortunately... no, I fear.

dialogues.speaker: Heinry
dialogues.text: You did help me retrieve a lot of documents previously, but I must confess that I might not have been in my right mind when writing them.

dialogues.speaker: Heinry
dialogues.text: A lot of the data and design concepts in here corroborate each other, but there are also some contradictions...

dialogues.speaker: Heinry
dialogues.text: I will need a bit more time to, ah, decipher these documents and try to understand what my thought process was back then.

dialogues.speaker: Heinry
dialogues.text: Of course, the collection process isn't going to stop, so could you continue helping with that? The search areas will be the same as before.

choices.text: Leave it to me.

response.speaker: Heinry
response.text: Thank you very much. Where'd you like to search this time?

choices.text: Alright, I'll do it for the Fonta.

dialogues.speaker: Heinry
dialogues.text: I can't believe you found these documents, and they haven't turned into a sopping wet mess... You really are my lucky star!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wait, why do you look so surprised... Weren't you very confident in this "waterproofing technique" of yours?

dialogues.speaker: Heinry
dialogues.text: Of course I had faith! I just, uh... lacked faith in the hydrological environment. Yes. The environment.

dialogues.speaker: Heinry
dialogues.text: You know what they say — "Even the best ship can't withstand all the turbulent tides."

choices.text: No one says that!

response.speaker: Heinry
response.text: *cough* Well! Uh, it's very good that we've retrieved these materials, in any case. Give me a moment to study their contents...

response.speaker: Black Screen
response.text: Heinry looks through the materials...

response.speaker: Heinry
response.text: Huh, so I once wanted to make Fonta that only contains fizz, while lacking any other flavor.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Wouldn't that just be plain soda?

response.speaker: Heinry
response.text: This material indicates that this was indeed the conclusion I came to at the time as well.

response.speaker: Heinry
response.text: The original purpose of this sort of Fonta was to help children who don't like drinking water get into it...

choices.text: You're quite the considerate sort, aren't you?

response.speaker: Heinry
response.text: Heh, since this is a design that past-me thought of, there's no need for me to give it up.

response.speaker: Heinry
response.text: Given that you did help me retrieve my materials, any new flavor I develop will also take your suggestions into account.

response.speaker: Heinry
response.text: Do you think that I should take this draft's suggestion and continue using the carbonated version?

choices.text: Remember to drink three glasses of water every day, Paimon.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Wait, why three? Is there some special meaning there?

choices.text: You'd better apologize to these documents later.

dialogues.speaker: Heinry
dialogues.text: I can't believe that these documents are so complete, and neither damaged by water or monsters... You truly are my lucky star!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: What state were the previous documents you retrieved in?

dialogues.speaker: Heinry
dialogues.text: Uh... Let's just say that I'd rather that they were destroyed.

dialogues.speaker: Heinry
dialogues.text: *cough* Well! Uh, it's very good that we've retrieved these materials, in any case. Give me a moment to study their contents...

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: Heinry looks through the materials...

dialogues.speaker: Heinry
dialogues.text: This design manuscript states that I once considered changing the base ingredient of Fonta to "tea leaves."

dialogues.speaker: Heinry
dialogues.text: ...And then I'd release a series of drinks based on different flavors of "tea," before promoting them in the Liyue market.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Tea flavored Fonta? And you want it in different flavors...? Paimon can't imagine what those would taste like...

choices.text: Likely bitter.

response.speaker: Heinry
response.text: It even says here that condensed tea extract, syrup, and milk can be added to adjust the flavor.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: That sounds interesting, but Paimon doesn't think this drink has anything to do with Fonta.

response.speaker: Heinry
response.text: Exactly, and that's why this plan was scrapped — because "it has nothing to do with our main product."

response.speaker: Heinry
response.text: However, I've decided to reinstate this plan — after all, developing a delicious tea-flavored drink might be interesting in its own right.

response.speaker: Heinry
response.text: However, you did help me retrieve my materials, so I'd like to hear what you have to say on the matter.

response.speaker: Heinry
response.text: Do you think that I should take the suggestion in this draft on board and try changing the base ingredient of Fonta to tea leaves?

choices.text: Apologize to the tea leaves before you start, thanks.

dialogues.speaker: Heinry
dialogues.text: Alright. It seems that the manner in which we're improving Fonta has got to change...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You want to improve Fonta?

dialogues.speaker: Heinry
dialogues.text: Ah, my dear Honorary Senior Researcher! Good to see you — most good, indeed!

dialogues.speaker: Heinry
dialogues.text: Do you still remember me? Well, you might not, considering how busy you were previously...

dialogues.speaker: Heinry
dialogues.text: But no matter! Allow me to introduce myself — Heinry, a member of the Fonta development team, at your service.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: You mentioned adjusting the way in which you're improving Fonta... are you developing some all-new version of it, or something?

dialogues.speaker: Heinry
dialogues.text: Hahaha, that's exactly what I've been doing all this time. We've had some successes and some failures, and some that even now stand at the crossroads between the two...

dialogues.speaker: Heinry
dialogues.text: But honestly, I've been working in business-related fields too much — I fear my mind's now closer to a merchant's than that of a researcher.

dialogues.speaker: Heinry
dialogues.text: As such, my recent development attempts have been rather uninspired, and my design plans have proved likewise...

dialogues.speaker: Heinry
dialogues.text: *sigh* I used to have all manner of fascinating ideas back when I worked at the Research Institute...

dialogues.speaker: Heinry
dialogues.text: But we wound up going with plans that would be easier for the public to accept, which would help Fonta sell better — many of my design drafts were left on the cutting room floor as a result.

dialogues.speaker: Heinry
dialogues.text: But I have always believed that those original drafts contain incredible inspirational value!

dialogues.speaker: Heinry
dialogues.text: My return to the Institute was also intended to find those drafts I left behind in my lab, and perhaps, even the samples I left behind.

dialogues.speaker: Heinry
dialogues.text: Basically, I hope that the passionate, inspired "past-me" can give "present-me" a bit of a boost.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh? Did that lab not get caught in the explosion?

dialogues.speaker: Heinry
dialogues.text: Hardly — it was blasted sky-high as well.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wait, then where would you even begin looking for your stuff? Are you gonna use magic to get those drafts out from the ground or something?

dialogues.speaker: Heinry
dialogues.text: Well, please let me finish. The lab was caught in the blast, yes, and that was a tragedy, but are those drafts not made of paper?

dialogues.speaker: Heinry
dialogues.text: They might just have been blown away rather than blown to bits — as such, they'd have floated down to the earth quite safely following the initial explosion.

choices.text: Your optimism brings tears to my eyes.

response.speaker: Heinry
response.text: Hahaha, thank you for the praise — I've always seen it as one of my principal virtues.

response.speaker: Heinry
response.text: I'm not joking here. The lab in which the Fonta research team was in was not that close to ground zero, so there's every chance that it was not directly hit by the explosion.

response.speaker: Heinry
response.text: In any case, our lab had been closed for some time at that point, and there weren't any active machines in there, so there was no risk of a fire, either.

response.speaker: Heinry
response.text: In the best case scenario, the documents and samples I left in there may indeed just have been knocked airborne by the shockwave rather than been utterly destroyed.

response.speaker: Heinry
response.text: And with the aid of some of my colleagues, I've also been able to calculate the possible locations of said materials! The only issue is that they're... a bit far away...

response.speaker: Heinry
response.text: So, my dear Honorary Senior Researcher, surely you would not leave Fonta and the Institute in the lurch, would you?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Well... If it's about a new Fonta flavor, {NICKNAME}, we could help him, couldn't we?

choices.text: Alright, Paimon, I'll do it for you...

response.speaker: Heinry
response.text: Splendid! With your aid, I'm yet more certain that we shall succeed. First, let me investigate the destination we're heading to this time.

response.speaker: Heinry
response.text: Let me see... Aha! There we go. First, search the vicinity of this spot — I'll mark this "Location 1" out on your map.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Uh, isn't this area mostly water? You sure your stuff hasn't fallen right in?

response.speaker: Heinry
response.text: Don't worry. When we sealed our materials, we waterproofed and insect-proofed every last sheet of paper.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Whoa, you've got techniques for that?

response.speaker: Heinry
response.text: Hahaha! It's hardly worthy of being called any "technique." We just put the manuscripts inside hardy waterproof bags and sealed them tightly.

choices.text: Let's get looking for the bags then...

response.speaker: Heinry
response.text: Right... Ah, yes — here's two bottles of Fonta for a quick pick-me-up!

choices.text: Let's just hope the bags didn't fly too far out...
Sure, let's do it for the Fonta.
You Institute folks are pretty good at rhetoric, aren't you?

response.speaker: Heinry
response.text: Well, we prefer to call this "being precise."

dialogues.speaker: Heinry
dialogues.text: Looks like I'll have to adjust my research direction... Well, not that it's the biggest problem ever...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Any new Fonta flavors available?

dialogues.speaker: Heinry
dialogues.text: Hello there. Unfortunately... no, I fear.

dialogues.speaker: Heinry
dialogues.text: You did help me retrieve a lot of documents previously, but I must confess that I might not have been in my right mind when writing them.

dialogues.speaker: Heinry
dialogues.text: A lot of the data and design concepts in here corroborate each other, but there are also some contradictions...

dialogues.speaker: Heinry
dialogues.text: I will need a bit more time to, ah, decipher these documents and try to understand what my thought process was back then.

dialogues.speaker: Heinry
dialogues.text: Of course, the collection process isn't going to stop, so could you continue helping with that? The search areas will be the same as before.

choices.text: Leave it to me.

response.speaker: Heinry
response.text: Splendid! With your aid, I'm yet more certain that we shall succeed. First, let me investigate the destination we're heading to this time.

response.speaker: Heinry
response.text: According to my calculations, some of the materials may have plummeted into the waters in this area... Let me mark this "Location 2" on your map...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Uh, wouldn't your drafts have become super-soaked by now, then?

response.speaker: Heinry
response.text: Uh... Well, I couldn't say, so we'll just have to check it out. In the meantime, let's have faith in Fontaine's waterproofing techniques!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Bah, you just put stuff inside bags! It's nothing that special!

choices.text: Let's get looking for the bags then...

response.speaker: Heinry
response.text: Right... Ah, yes — here's two bottles of Fonta for a quick pick-me-up!

choices.text: Let's just hope the bags didn't fly too far out...
Alright, I'll do it for the Fonta.

response.text: Splendid! With your aid, I'm yet more certain that we shall succeed. First, let me investigate the destination we're heading to this time.

response.speaker: Heinry
response.text: Based on the results of my calculations, some of the documents should have landed in this area. I'll mark this "Location 3" on your map...

response.speaker: Heinry
response.text: Some of my colleagues mentioned that they picked some paper up nearby, and that they also appeared to be office paper commonly used in the Fontaine Research Institute.

response.speaker: Heinry
response.text: Let's go try our luck... Um, I mean, assess the situation there.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: So, your real feelings have come out, huh...

choices.text: Might as well try our luck, then.

response.speaker: Heinry
response.text: Yes, yes. Come, here's two bottles of Fonta to raise your spirits a bit!

choices.text: Might as well go check it out.
